name: PixiTween Director S12c: crew workers (builders, blind critic, continuity, takes)
description: The workers the scheduler runs: scene builders for build, rebuild, restyle, edit, fix and revert jobs (Spark, or Glimmer on the local lane), scoped to one scene and abortable; the blind critic that asks the browser for frames; cross-scene continuity checks; and takes as child films with thumbnails, scores and a splice on pick.

readFirst: docs/hackathon/steps/step-05-self-review-loop/design.md (frame sampling, rules and the review prompt)
extraGuardrails: Shared edits are small and stated: build-scene.ts gains optional extraSystem, toolFilter and signal options (defaults keep today's behaviour); review.ts resolves a waiting critique when POST /frames carries a matching requestId; visual.ts gains a blind option; read-routes.ts hides films with parentId from GET /api/films.
The critic's prompt must never contain the storyboard, a scene intent, a job brief or the style bible.
manualGates: MG-4 (shared with S12d): in the browser with the engine fix installed, a crew film's critique jobs receive captured frames (no 'no browser connected' summaries) and one take request shows three thumbnails.

stories.title: buildScene options: extraSystem, toolFilter, signal
stories.description: As a builder worker, I want to give buildScene the style bible, the job brief, a tool list and an abort signal so that crew builds reuse S3b's tested loop.
steps: Read server/agent/build-scene.ts and server/agent/prompts/director.ts (buildScenePrompt).

Edit server/agent/build-scene.ts: BuildSceneOptions gains extraSystem?: string (appended to the system prompt), toolFilter?: (tool) => boolean (replacing the EDIT_ONLY filter when given) and signal?: AbortSignal (checked before each model turn and each tool call; passed to chatWithTools). When aborted, return with stalled false and a new field aborted: true.
Edit server/agent/prompts/director.ts only if buildScenePrompt needs an extra parameter for extraSystem.
Extend server/agent/director.test.ts or add server/agent/build-scene.options.test.ts with makeFakeBackend.
acceptance: With extraSystem 'STYLE BIBLE x', the first message sent to the backend contains 'STYLE BIBLE x'
A signal aborted after the first turn stops before the second model call and the result has aborted true
Without the new options, all existing director and build-scene tests pass unchanged

stories.title: Scene scope guard for worker tool calls
stories.description: As a scheduler, I want a builder to touch only its own scene so that parallel builders never step on each other.
steps: Read server/tools/registry.ts (runTool) and design.md section 5.8.

Create server/crew/workers/scope.ts exporting scopedRunTool(sceneId) => (ctx, name, args) that rejects args with sceneId !== the job's scene, or layerId not starting with '<sceneId>:', returning { ok: false, error: 'out of scope: this job owns scene <id> only' }, and otherwise calls runTool.
Create server/crew/workers/scope.test.ts.
acceptance: scopedRunTool('s2') with args { layerId: 's1:headline' } returns ok false and the exact error 'out of scope: this job owns scene s2 only'
scopedRunTool('s2') with { sceneId: 's2', … } reaches runTool (spy called once)
A tool with neither sceneId nor layerId in its args is allowed

stories.title: Builder worker for build, rebuild, restyle, edit, fix and revert
stories.description: As a crew, I want one builder worker that handles every scene-writing job kind so that the showrunner's briefs become timeline changes.
steps: Read design.md sections 5.8 and 6.4, server/crew/prompts.ts (renderBibleBlock, renderJobBlock), server/crew/scene-snapshot.ts and server/agent/build-scene.ts.

Create server/crew/workers/builder.ts exporting runBuilderJob({ deps, job, signal, film }): build-scene uses buildScene with the bible + job block, the default tools and scopedRunTool; rebuild-scene first removes the scene's non-camera layers with the authoring core inside one mutate; restyle-scene, edit and fix use all tools including edit-only; revert restores the snapshot of the previous done writing job on that scene with no model. Returns { summary, version, costUsd }.
Set ctx.source to 'director' for build kinds and 'chat' for edit, fix and restyle; record Spark cost with ctx.ledger as today.
Create server/crew/workers/builder.test.ts with makeTestFilm and makeFakeBackend.
acceptance: A build-scene job whose fake backend makes 3 valid calls returns a summary containing '3 tool calls, 3 ok'
A rebuild-scene job on a scene with 4 layers leaves only the layers the fake backend adds (plus camera)
A revert job restores the scene to the snapshot of its last done job with zero backend calls

stories.title: Local lane: edit jobs on Glimmer in Local mode
stories.description: As a user in Local mode, I want edit jobs to run on Muse Glimmer and show on the local lane so that open weights do visible work.
steps: Read server/llm/router.ts (pickBackend('edit', { local })), server/llm/local-mode.ts and server/crew/workers/builder.ts.

Edit server/crew/workers/builder.ts: edit and fix jobs use pickBackend('edit', { local: getLocalMode() }); when the backend id is 'glimmer', set job.worker 'local', job.model to GLIMMER_MODEL and emit crew.agent with lane 'local'.
Extend server/crew/workers/builder.test.ts with local mode on and a fake Glimmer backend.
acceptance: With local mode on, an edit job's emitted crew.agent event has lane 'local' and the job's worker is 'local'
With local mode off, the same job runs on the Spark fake and lane 'builder'

stories.title: Critic worker: capture request and the frames bridge
stories.description: As a critic, I want the browser to send me frames of a finished scene so that I judge what is really on screen.
steps: Read design.md section 5.9, server/review/sample.ts, server/http/handlers/review.ts and server/review/loop.ts.

Create server/crew/workers/critic.ts exporting runCriticJob({ deps, job, signal }) and a waiting map: it computes times with sample.ts for the scene, emits capture.request { requestId, filmId, sceneId, timesSec }, sets the job 'awaiting-frames', and awaits resolveCapture(requestId, frames, textBoxes) or CREW_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS.
Edit server/http/handlers/review.ts: when the multipart body carries requestId and it is waiting, call resolveCapture and reply { review: 'crew' } instead of starting runReview.
Create server/crew/workers/critic.test.ts.
acceptance: runCriticJob emits one capture.request whose timesSec all fall inside the scene's start and end
POST /frames with that requestId resolves the job and does not call runReview (spy)
With fake timers and no frames, the job ends done after CREW_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS with summary 'no browser connected; rules only'

stories.title: Blind review prompt and findings to the inbox
stories.description: As a showrunner, I want the critic to report only what is visible so that its findings are independent evidence.
steps: Read server/review/visual.ts (the frame-review prompt), design.md section 6.5 and server/crew/workers/critic.ts.

Edit server/review/visual.ts: add a blind option that builds the prompt from frames, measured text boxes and rule facts only, with the two extra sentences of design 6.5. Without the option the prompt is unchanged.

Edit server/crew/workers/critic.ts: after frames arrive, run the deterministic rules, then pickReviewer().reviewImages with blind: true; emit review.finding events and push one inbox item { from: 'critic', jobId, text } listing the findings with second and kind.
Extend server/crew/workers/critic.test.ts.
acceptance: For a scene with intent 'golden sunrise over the counter', the blind prompt string contains neither 'golden' nor 'sunrise' nor 'counter'
Two fake findings produce two review.finding events and one inbox item from 'critic'
Existing visual.ts tests pass unchanged without the blind option

stories.title: Continuity checks across scenes
stories.description: As a showrunner, I want cross-scene consistency checked by code so that the film looks like one film.
steps: Read design.md section 5.12, server/review/rules.ts and server/review/geometry.ts.

Create server/crew/continuity.ts exporting runContinuity(comp, assets, bible) returning runRules' findings plus product-scale-drift (same shotType, height fraction differs by more than 35 %), palette-drift (RGB distance over 48 from every bible colour) and type-drift (headline font or weight differs from bible.type), each with severity warn, and a runContinuityJob worker that pushes new findings to the inbox from 'continuity'.
Create server/crew/continuity.test.ts with fixtures/s12c/continuity-*.json compositions.
acceptance: Two hero scenes with product height fractions 0.40 and 0.60 give one product-scale-drift finding; 0.40 and 0.50 give none
A headline fill '#ff0000' with bible palette ['#1f2937', '#f59e0b'] gives palette-drift; '#f5a00e' does not
A second run with no new findings pushes nothing to the inbox

stories.title: Takes as child films, hidden from the gallery
stories.description: As a user, I want three takes of a scene built side by side so that I can choose the best one.
steps: Read design.md section 5.10, server/store/film-store.ts (create, parentId) and server/http/read-routes.ts.

Create server/crew/takes.ts exporting createTakes({ deps }) with start(job) which creates N child films (parentId, same brief, crew false) whose first commit is the parent's composition, and queues one rebuild-scene job per child with filmId = child id, takeOf = job.id, takeLabel A/B/C and the fixed variation hints of the design appended to the brief.
Edit server/http/read-routes.ts: GET /api/films leaves out films with parentId.
Create server/crew/takes.test.ts.
acceptance: A take job with takes 3 creates 3 child films with parentId set and 3 rebuild jobs labelled A, B and C
Take B's brief ends with 'bolder: closer framing, a stronger camera move'
GET /api/films lists the parent and none of its children

stories.title: Take thumbnails and scores
stories.description: As a user, I want a thumbnail and a score per take so that the choice is quick.
steps: Read server/generate/flatten.ts and server/media/image.ts (flatten) and design.md section 5.10 steps 3 and 4.

Edit server/crew/takes.ts: when a take's rebuild job ends done, flatten the child's scene plate and product cut-out at their mid-scene boxes into a 640-px-wide PNG asset (role 'frame'), score it 0-10 as 10 minus 2 per deterministic rule finding minus 1 per blind-critic finding (floor 0), and emit take.ready.
Extend server/crew/takes.test.ts.
acceptance: A finished take emits take.ready with a thumbAssetId whose asset is a PNG 640 px wide
A take with one rule finding and one critic finding scores 7

stories.title: pickTake splices the chosen scene into the parent
stories.description: As a showrunner or the user, I want picking a take to replace the scene in the real film so that the choice takes effect.
steps: Read server/crew/scene-snapshot.ts (spliceScene) and server/crew/showrunner-tools.ts (the injected takes.pick).

Edit server/crew/takes.ts: pick(parentId, takeFilmId) checks the child's parentId, runs films.mutate(parent, c => spliceScene(c, sceneId, childComp), 'director', 'take <label>'), and queues continuity and critique on the parent scene.
Extend server/crew/takes.test.ts.
acceptance: After pick, the parent's scene precomp deep-equals the child's and the other parent scenes are unchanged
pick with a film whose parentId is another film returns ok false with error 'not a take of this film'

stories.title: Worker registry wired into runCrew
stories.description: As a scheduler, I want each job kind mapped to its worker so that the crew runs real work.
steps: Read server/crew/run-crew.ts (the injectable worker registry) and the workers in server/crew/workers/.

Create server/crew/workers/registry.ts exporting createWorkerRegistry(deps) mapping build-scene, rebuild-scene, restyle-scene, edit, fix and revert to runBuilderJob, critique to runCriticJob, continuity to runContinuityJob and take to takes.start, and register it as runCrew's default.
Add server/crew/workers/registry.test.ts.
acceptance: createWorkerRegistry(deps)['restyle-scene'] is runBuilderJob and ['critique'] is runCriticJob
A fake crew film (S12b fake showrunner) run with the real registry and fake Meta ends 'ready' with continuity and critique jobs done for every scene

stories.title: Turn off the S5b auto-review on crew films
stories.description: As a critic, I want to be the only reviewer of a crew film so that no scene is reviewed and billed twice.
steps: Read server/http/handlers/review.ts and design.md section 5.9 (last paragraph).
Edit server/http/handlers/review.ts: a POST /frames without requestId on a film with crew true returns 409 { error: 'crew_reviews' } and starts nothing.
Extend the review handler test.
acceptance: POST /frames without requestId on a crew film returns 409 crew_reviews and runReview is not called
POST /frames on a non-crew film behaves as before
